Excellent customer service to all patrons of the caf .

Dynamic multidisciplinary team

result.description:
This privatly owned practice has been open for 25  years and has a strong reputation for providing quality health services to the residents 

 Fully accredited practice with a team of General Practitioners, along with a comprehensive range of Allied Health, specialists and diagnostic services provided on-site. 

 Whilst the medical centre provides a broad range of general family medical services, many of the doctors have special interests, and they cater for each of these by incorporating clinics in; skin cancer, occupational health, cosmetic, and women's health. 

   

 This  purpose built, state of the art facility with street front access. They are a fully air-conditioned centre with 21 consulting rooms, spacious waiting rooms, 4 treatment rooms (including two procedure rooms), 4 psychologist rooms, a range of allied health suites, a staff room, staff toilets, and a meeting room. We have a Pathology Collection centre, Radiology and Pharmacy all on-site. 

   

  PATIENT DEMAND  

 Exceptionally high demand for our services, and all doctors are kept busy with a constant flow of patients during their working hours. 

   

   

  TREATMENT ROOM  

 Four treatment rooms, two of which are designed as procedural rooms. Skin cancer clinic at the practice, so we are also interested in talking with doctors who would like to specialise in skin cancer checks and procedures, with all the essential equipment on-site including; an audiometry machine, spirometer, alcohol breath testing, and all emergency and skin cancer related equipment. Our nurses have also been trained in the management of fractures with plaster and fibreglass. 

   

  ADMIN SETUP  

 Fully computerised and accredited facility, using Medical Director and Pracsoft. Two practice managers, an accountant, and a large team of reception staff to provide all of the administrative support you need. 

   

  NURSING SERVICES  

 Full-time Registered Nurses, who have all been fully trained in General Practice Nursing. They can perform all general practice nursing duties and in addition have been trained to administer plaster and fibreglass of non-displaced fractures. 

   

  ALLIED HEALTH SERVICES  

 Wide range of Allied health staff onsite, including four Psychologists, two Dieticians, three Dentists, three Physiotherapists, two Exercise Physiologists, a Chiropractor, a Podiatrist, and an Audiology Clinic. 

   

  DIAGNOSTIC SERVICES  

 Practice has a SydPath Collection centre onsite, available for extended hours, seven days per week. Radiology centre onsite for X-Rays, which is open seven days per week. 

   

  OTHER CLINICAL SERVICES  

 Practice has a large and well-established Skin Cancer Clinic. We have a number of doctors interested in occupational health, and we also have a cosmetic clinic and women's health clinic. 

   

   

  BILLING ARRANGEMENTS  

 Our practice Bulk-Bills for all eligible services. 

  Essential Criteria  

 
	 Strong verbal and written communication skills 
	 Vocational Registration (FRACGP | FACRRM | FRNZCGP) 
	 Full Australian Work Rights 
	 General Prac    Apply Now
